title: Insecure Data Storage
description: Parent account data stored in MongoDB may be exposed if the datastore lacks proper security controls (e.g., encryption, access restrictions).
assumptions: MongoDB is configured without default security hardening.
uncertainty_note: Node Dd.1.1 assumed based on common LINDDUN patterns; exact node may vary.

title: Identifiable Data Storage
description: Parent account data may contain personally identifiable information (PII) that could be linked to individuals if not anonymized.
assumptions: Parent account data includes PII such as names, emails, or identifiers.
uncertainty_note: Node I.1.1 inferred; exact node depends on data sensitivity.

title: Non-Compliant Data Processing
description: Storing parent account data may violate privacy regulations (e.g., GDPR) if consent or legal basis is not established.
assumptions: Data processing lacks explicit user consent or lawful basis.
uncertainty_note: Node Nc.1.1 assumed; compliance depends on jurisdiction and data type.

title: Direct Identification of Child
description: Child profile data (name, DOB, government ID) stored in P3 can directly identify the child, enabling unauthorized tracking or profiling.
assumptions: Data is stored without pseudonymization or access controls.

title: Unauthorized Disclosure of Sensitive Data
description: Child's government ID and personal details may be disclosed to unauthorized parties due to inadequate data protection in P3.
assumptions: Data transmission/storage lacks encryption or access restrictions.

title: Lack of Transparency in Data Usage
description: Parent (EE1) may not be informed about how child's data is processed, stored, or shared by P3.
assumptions: No clear privacy notices or consent mechanisms are provided.

title: Non-Compliance with Child Privacy Regulations
description: P3 may fail to comply with regulations like COPPA/GDPR regarding child data handling (e.g., parental consent, data minimization).
assumptions: Process lacks compliance checks for child-specific legal requirements.

title: Unauthorized Access to Stored Government ID Images
description: The File System (DS4) may lack sufficient access controls, allowing unauthorized parties to access stored government ID images, leading to potential data breaches.
assumptions: Assumes DS4 does not enforce strict file permissions or encryption at rest.

title: Non-Compliance with Data Protection Regulations
description: The Authentication Service (P1) may store government ID images without ensuring compliance with legal requirements (e.g., GDPR), such as purpose limitation, data minimization, or retention policies.
assumptions: Assumes P1 does not validate legal basis or implement required safeguards before storing sensitive data.
